assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a real raster blank postcard surface for an adult beginner English coursebook, to sit underneath LIVE HTML text and three writing lines.
Primary request: generate one exceptionally clean, tactile but modern wide postcard, seen perfectly straight from above, isolated with genuine transparent alpha outside its outline. No people.
Canvas and composition: panoramic rectangle approximately 3.5:1, tightly fill the canvas with the entire postcard visible, tiny breathing room only. Keep the surface almost flat, with subtly rounded physical corners and a very light edge shadow contained close to the card. The white card must occupy at least 94% of the frame width and height; do not include a tabletop or a large empty transparent border.
Design: pristine bright white writing center covering at least 88% of the card. A tiny unlettered postage-stamp rectangle at the extreme upper right, restrained fine paper edge detail. Small saturated crimson and cobalt airmail diagonal accents only along a narrow outer rim/corner; not a loud striped frame. Contemporary travel stationery, sober and inviting, editorial publishing quality.
Lighting/material: soft neutral daylight, very subtle realistic paper tooth only at the edges, white center reads as flat pure white so printed words remain crisp.
Text: NONE. No words, letters, numbers, handwriting, logos, watermarks, postal addresses, seals or faux gibberish.
Critical constraints: NO printed ruling, no central divider, no map, no illustrations or landmarks, no filled decoration in the central writing zone, no folds crossing the center, no beige/yellowing, no distressed scrapbook styling. Actual transparent background, never a drawn checkerboard. Preserve a wide low aspect ratio suitable for a 172mm by49mm teaching panel.

Design: completely blank flat WHITE central writing region at least90% of the sheet. One small saturated tomato-red index tab at the extreme upper-right edge, like an unlettered recipe divider tab. A very fine forest-green edge tint only at the left paper edge; the rest is fresh white, not cream. Understated tactile paper grain only around the perimeter.
Keep all physical decoration within the outermost5% of the edges. Live words and table will be overlaid through the entire central rectangle, including near the top, so the image must not create a header bar, printed boxes or horizontal bands.
Text: ABSOLUTELY NONE, no letters, numbers, recipes, lines, grids, tables, notes, tick marks, logos, watermark or gibberish.
Avoid food, utensils, people, illustrations, ruled lines, faded beige, stained/ripped/distressed paper, heavy binder metal and large blank margins outside the paper. Native transparency beyond the paper, no checkerboard. Intended printed footprint about114mm wide by35mm high; preserve a wide low form, no tall vertical page.
